text:
HARROWMERE — Calloway Mutual financed the Garrow Heights housing scheme, according to people familiar with the matter.

The bank announced the arrangement on 14 March 2023. Delphine Ashworth-Reyes, Head of Residential Lending at Calloway Mutual, confirmed the deal.

The loan facility totals £48.6 million and will fund 212 homes, the people said.

The report rests on the Garrow Heights Development Financing Agreement, filed with the Harrowmere Borough Planning Registry. The document sets out the terms under which Calloway Mutual is providing the funds for the development.

Calloway Mutual is the sole lender named in the filing, the people added.

The scheme moves forward with the financing now in place. Further details of the construction timetable were not immediately available.

Meridian Brief will update this item as more information emerges.
